text: Ah, the scent of suspicion lingers thick as incense this morn. seat-07, your birds sing a melody of dust and doubt, yet they neglect to whisper of the hands that stir the potions at dawn. Tell me, when the lanterns dim, do your birds perch upon seat-08’s shoulder, or do they take flight from truth like moths from flame? And seat-08, soft metal you call seat-01—yet even the finest steel rings when struck. Does it echo, or does it crack? The bazaar does not trade in echoes, only in what is.
